name: Community Chest Biodiversity Grants
summary: Grants from a district council for community groups and parish or town councils to plant native trees, hedgerows and wildflower meadows, put up bird and bat boxes, and create or improve wildlife habitat in South Cambridgeshire.

amount.note: Maximum award in any single financial year, can cover 100% of project costs

reporting: An end-of-project evaluation is due within three months of the project's completion.

applicant_types.quote: Biodiversity Grants (currently closed for applications) Who can apply: Community Group (including Community Interest Companies) Parish/Town Council of any size

geography.quote: This includes Community Interest Companies, (CIC) based in South Cambridgeshire or benefiting South Cambridgeshire residents.

access.quote: Apply for a Community Chest Grant

amount.quote: The maximum award is £2,000 in any single financial year (April to March) and can be for 100% of project costs.

co_finance_required.quote: Where appropriate, applicants are encouraged to seek part-funding from other sources including their Parish/Town council. There is no requirement for this

reporting.quote: an end of project evaluation must be submitted to us within 3-months of project completion
